steps.text: Sunday's jerk chickpeas (110/135 g, seasoned with 2/3 g of the jar's jerk rub), straight from the jar. If they've softened, 4 minutes in a hot dry pan brings the crunch back.
Skyr (50/70 g) in a small bowl, mashed with the avocado (20/28 g) and the oil (7/9 g), lime and salt.

why: Store them in a jar with the lid OFF, not a sealed box. Sealed, the residual steam softens them overnight and you lose the rattle, which is the entire point of them.
notes: D0-020 (yield headroom): Sunday roasts 250 g drained chickpeas; this snack's covers sum to 245 g (110+135) — 5 g headroom, now stated explicitly in prep-a.json's yield rather than left silent.
D0-003: the finishing oil in the dip (mashed with skyr/avocado, no heat) stays olive_oil.

Seasoning weighing: the 2 tsp jerk seasoning on Sunday's chickpea tray was never gram-tracked. Standard-reference jerk_seasoning (dry rub) added, 5 g total for the tray, split 2/3 g her/him proportional to the chickpea share consumed. Drift +6/+9 kcal, both under the 30 kcal note threshold but recorded here for traceability.
